record.question: Human Development Index (HDI) is calculated using which three indicators?
record.explanation: Answer A: Health, Education, Income. UNDP’s HDI combines health (life expectancy), education, and standard of living (income). Reference: https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/human-development-index. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
